This chunk is about:
- Events: 2007 Trail Appliances Autumn Gold Curling Classic, 2009 Manitoba Scotties Tournament of Hearts
- People: Jennifer Jones, Cathy Overton-Clapham, Jill Officer, Dawn Askin, Rachel Homan
- Places: Calgary Curling Club, Calgary, Alberta, Sochi
- Topics: Women's World Curling Tour, Grand Slam, Olympic gold medal, World Women's Curling Championship, Scotties Tournament of Hearts

Facts:
- The 2007 Trail Appliances Autumn Gold Curling Classic was the 30th annual edition of the event.
- The 2007 Trail Appliances Autumn Gold Curling Classic was the first Grand Slam event of the Women's World Curling Tour.
- The 2007 Trail Appliances Autumn Gold Curling Classic was held from October 5 to 9 at the Calgary Curling Club in Calgary, Alberta.
- The 2007 Trail Appliances Autumn Gold Curling Classic had a total purse of $56,000, with $14,000 awarded to the winning team of Jennifer Jones, Cathy Overton-Clapham, Jill Officer, and Dawn Askin.
- Jennifer Jones won the 2008 Scotties Tournament of Hearts and therefore qualified for the 2009 Manitoba Scotties Tournament of Hearts as Team Canada.
- Jennifer Jones and her team won the 2008 World Women's Curling Championship, and they were the last Canadian women's team to do so until Rachel Homan in 2017.
- Jennifer Jones won an Olympic gold medal as skip of the Canadian team at the 2014 Sochi Games.
